records.name: Villainous Mode
records.reason: Maintained structured Xenoverse 2 research classifies Villainous Mode as an enemy/story-character state rather than an unlockable retail CaC transformation. CaCs can temporarily enter the state in Crystal Raid/Training contexts, but that does not make it an equippable retail Awoken Skill.

records.name: Supervillain Mode
records.reason: Maintained structured research classifies Supervillain Mode and its stages as enemy/story-character buff states, not unlockable CaC transformations. Crystal Raid can apply a villainous state to a CaC for the battle, but this is a mode-specific state rather than a retail equippable Awoken Skill.

records.name: Ultra Supervillain
records.reason: Current retail Ultra Supervillain implementations are attached to roster characters in Future Saga content rather than provided as a CaC-equippable Awoken Skill. Current character data lists Ultra Supervillain forms as distinct cast-character variants, while maintained research excludes villainous modes from retail CaC transformations.

note: Villainous states are kept separate from retail CaC-equippable Awoken Skills; Crystal Raid CaC access is a temporary mode-specific state, not a race restriction.
